As a fan of the Legend of Heroes series, it pisses me off that Falcom still refuses to release an official English translation of the game in the West. Luckily, the Geofront Fan Translation Project has at last completed, and you can now enjoy a more accurate, fan translation of the game, including additional PC specific features, such as higher resolution support, updated graphics (comparitivly) and Turbo mode. Unlike previous fan translations, you will need to obtain the PSVita Evolution voice acting patches yourself, should you want them. This post deals solely with getting English text in the game up and running

Getting it working is similar to a previous post I made on the topic, but has some additional steps, so, without further ado, let's go:

Note: As there is no official western release of this game, the only way to obtain this version is to pirate or legally purchase the Jap version and then apply the patch. Your options should you wish to do that can be seen here. It sucks, but if a company will not provide a product, a means will appear to fill that lack. I won't link it here, but there are torrents and even a few websites still up where you can download the iso directly so, enjoy.

WINEARCH = 32bit

WINEVERSION = 5.4-Staging (this is an old game, so older versions of Wine will most likely work as well)

WINETRICKS = amstream, quartz, dotnet4, dotnet4.8 (dotnet is required for the Geofront Patch Installer)

DLLOVERRIDES = dinput8 (native,builtin)

VARIABLES = LC_ALL = ja_JP.UTF-8

3RD PARTY INSTALLS = LAVFilters (install as a prerequisite by the Geofront Patch Installer)

Install Steps

  • Create your 32bit Wineprefix. You can follow guides listed in this sub, or use an alternative method, so long as it is setup correctly.
  • Use Winetricks to install all additional MS DLL/Components listed above into the prefix.
  • Obtain an unpatched copy of the JP PC Version of Trails from Zero, and Download the Geofront Patch
  • Extract the Geofront Patch files and rename all files with a .deploy extension so they are just normal .dll/.exe files etc...
  • Execute the ZeroLauncher.exe file within your 32bit Prefix.
  • When the Installer runs, browse to where you downloaded the JP PC release and locate the FSetup5.exe file. This will allow the Installer to verify you have an original, unpatched copy of the game and use it to install the game in your prefix, prior to patching it.
  • Click Install and accept the default install location for the Game Files. The Geofront Installer will now apply any missing prerequisites and patch the game after installing it.
  • Finally, use Winecfg to set dinput8 (native, builtin) and you'll be good to go.

And that's it. The dinput8 override is essential, as this is how the patch is "hooked" into the game and make it's changes. Without it, the characters will not be voiced and they'll just spit out a bunch of gibberish in the text bubbles.
